title: [Master]-Rounding Differences in ARAP with Deferrals and Non-Deductible VAT
summary: Rounding differences in accounts receivable/payable with deferrals and non-deductible VAT are corrected in the Gen. Jnl.-Post Line codeunit across all localization layers. Test cases were added to verify the fix.
key_points: Fixes rounding calculation issues in journal posting with deferrals and non-deductible VAT combinations
Updates applied consistently across 11 localization layers (W1, APAC, BE, CH, ES, FI, FR, IT, NA, NO, RU)
Test coverage added for non-deductible VAT scenarios to prevent regression
Affects the core posting logic in codeunit 12
No breaking changes to public interfaces or events
